description: This file defines multiple Orleans grain classes used for testing activation and garbage collection behaviors, including idle and busy activation grains, collection-specific age limit grains, and a stateless worker grain.

classes.name: IdleActivationGcTestGrain1
classes.description: A simple idle activation grain implementing IIdleActivationGcTestGrain1 for test purposes.

classes.name: IdleActivationGcTestGrain2
classes.description: Another idle activation grain implementing IIdleActivationGcTestGrain2.

classes.name: BusyActivationGcTestGrain1
classes.description: A busy activation grain with additional methods and dependencies, implements IBusyActivationGcTestGrain1.

classes.name: BusyActivationGcTestGrain2
classes.description: A simple busy activation test grain implementing IBusyActivationGcTestGrain2.

classes.name: CollectionSpecificAgeLimitForTenSecondsActivationGcTestGrain
classes.description: A grain with a specific collection age limit of ten seconds for testing collection behavior.

classes.name: CollectionSpecificAgeLimitForZeroSecondsActivationGcTestGrain
classes.description: A grain with a zero-second collection age limit for testing immediate collection.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerActivationCollectorTestGrain1
classes.description: A stateless worker grain used for testing activation collection, with identifiable instance ID.

methods.name: Nop
methods.description: A method that does nothing and immediately completes, used as a no-operation placeholder.

methods.name: Delay
methods.description: Delays execution for a specified TimeSpan.

methods.name: IdentifyActivation
methods.description: Returns a string identifier for the activation.
